title: Private Tour of Oahu for 6 to 11 people - up to 8 hours
includes: Car Seats or boosters for children
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a Private Custom tour of the island of Oahu. You can tell us in your reservation what you would like to do, and then discuss it with your driver when they pick you up. Each van has a cooler with ice and water. You have the van and tour guide for up to 8 hours to do what you'd like to do. The driver will narrate during the tour and at the stops about the history and culture of Hawaii.
We provide Private, Custom, tours of the island of Oahu. You can set the itinerary or leave it up to our expert guides, or a mix of both. We've been giving tours since 2012. Check out our TripAdvisor reviews to see what people enjoyed doing. We pick you up right from your hotel, we recommend 8:30am. Look for a tour van with white letters on the side that says our name. Please contact us to let us know your start time. 
Note that the Honolulu City Council has banned All tour companies from certain beaches, which affects their ability to do snorkeling from the beach.
